title: Betrayal and Arrest, Peter's Denial, Jesus Before Pilate

questions.question: After the prayer, Jesus went with His disciples across the brook Kidron where there was a garden. Who knew this place?
options: Judas, who betrayed him
Caiaphas the high priest
Pontius Pilate's soldiers
The Sanhedrin leaders
questions.explanation: John 18:2 (ESV): "Now Judas, who betrayed him, also knew the place, for Jesus often met there with his disciples."

questions.question: When Jesus said "I am he" to those seeking Jesus of Nazareth, what happened to the soldiers?
options: They drew back and fell to the ground
They immediately arrested him
They fled in terror completely
They bowed down and worshipped him
questions.correctAnswer: They drew back and fell to the ground
questions.explanation: John 18:6 (ESV): "When Jesus said to them, 'I am he,' they drew back and fell to the ground."

questions.question: Who struck the high priest's servant, cutting off his right ear? What was the servant's name?
options: Simon Peter; the servant's name was Malchus
Thomas; the servant's name was Malchus
James; the servant's name was Barabbas
Andrew; the servant's name was Lazarus
questions.correctAnswer: Simon Peter; the servant's name was Malchus
questions.explanation: John 18:10 (ESV): "Then Simon Peter, having a sword, drew it and struck the high priest's servant and cut off his right ear. (The servant's name was Malchus.)"

questions.question: What did Jesus say to Peter about putting his sword away?
options: "Put your sword into its sheath; shall I not drink the cup that the Father has given me?"
"Those who live by the sword die by the sword."
"I need no defense, for angels guard me."
"Drop it now, that the Scripture may be fulfilled."
questions.correctAnswer: "Put your sword into its sheath; shall I not drink the cup that the Father has given me?"
questions.explanation: John 18:11 (ESV): "So Jesus said to Peter, 'Put your sword into its sheath; shall I not drink the cup that the Father has given me?'"

questions.question: Peter was warming himself by a fire in the courtyard. When a servant girl asked if he was one of Jesus' disciples, what was his reply?
options: "I am not."
"I do not know the man."
"Who is Jesus?"
"I know nothing of him."
questions.explanation: John 18:17 (ESV): "The servant girl at the door said to Peter, 'You also are not one of this man's disciples, are you?' He said, 'I am not.'"

questions.question: When the high priest questioned Jesus about His disciples and teaching, how did Jesus respond?
options: "I have spoken openly to the world... Ask those who have heard me what I said to them; they know what I said."
"I will not speak a word to you entirely."
"My disciples are loyal and will tell you safely."
"My teaching is written in the ancient scrolls."
questions.correctAnswer: "I have spoken openly to the world... Ask those who have heard me what I said to them; they know what I said."
questions.explanation: John 18:20-21 (ESV): "Jesus answered him, 'I have spoken openly to the world... Ask those who have heard me what I said to them; they know what I said.'"

questions.question: For what reason did the Jews not enter Pilate's headquarters themselves?
options: So that they would not be defiled, but could eat the Passover
Because they feared a Roman ambush inside
Because Roman law forbade it on feast days
Because Pilate had insulted them previously
questions.correctAnswer: So that they would not be defiled, but could eat the Passover
questions.explanation: John 18:28 (ESV): "...but they themselves did not enter the governor's headquarters, so that they would not be defiled, but could eat the Passover."

questions.question: Pilate asked Jesus, "Are you the King of the Jews?" Jesus explained His kingdom is not of this world. If it were, what did He say His servants would have done?
options: They would have been fighting, that I might not be delivered over to the Jews
They would have prayed fiercely for an angel army
They would have hidden me safely in the desert
They would have bribed the soldiers entirely
questions.correctAnswer: They would have been fighting, that I might not be delivered over to the Jews
questions.explanation: John 18:36 (ESV): "Jesus answered, 'My kingdom is not of this world. If my kingdom were of this world, my servants would have been fighting, that I might not be delivered over to the Jews.'"

questions.question: Jesus told Pilate: "For this purpose I was born and for this purpose I have come into the world—to bear witness to the truth." What was Pilate's famous cynical reply?
options: "What is truth?"
"Truth belongs to Caesar."
"No man knows the truth."
"Your truth means nothing here."
questions.explanation: John 18:38 (ESV): "Pilate said to him, 'What is truth?'"

questions.question: Who had been thrown in prison for insurrection and was released by Pilate instead of Jesus at the crowd's request?
options: Barabbas
Gestas
Dismas
Thaddaeus
questions.explanation: John 18:40 (ESV): "They cried out again, 'Not this man, but Barabbas!' Now Barabbas was a robber."

questions.question: First Jesus was led to which former high priest before being taken to Caiaphas?
options: Annas
Eli
Zacharias
Joazar
questions.explanation: John 18:13 (ESV): "First they led him to Annas, for he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year."

questions.question: When Peter denied Jesus a third time, at the same moment what happened?
options: And immediately a rooster crowed
And the earth shook briefly
And the lamp in the courtyard went out
And Judas fled into the darkness
questions.explanation: John 18:27 (ESV): "Peter again denied it, and at once a rooster crowed."

questions.question: When the officer struck Jesus for His answer to the high priest, what did Jesus say?
options: "If what I said is wrong, bear witness about the wrong; but if what I said is right, why do you strike me?"
"Father, forgive him, for he knows not what he does."
"Do you strike the King of the universe?"
"My hour has not yet come to respond."
questions.correctAnswer: "If what I said is wrong, bear witness about the wrong; but if what I said is right, why do you strike me?"
questions.explanation: John 18:23 (ESV): "Jesus answered him, 'If what I said is wrong, bear witness about the wrong; but if what I said is right, why do you strike me?'"

questions.question: What relationship did Caiaphas have to Annas?
options: He was the son-in-law of Annas
He was the brother of Annas
He was the successor appointed by Annas
He was the father of Annas
questions.correctAnswer: He was the son-in-law of Annas
questions.explanation: John 18:13 (ESV): "he was the father-in-law of Caiaphas, who was high priest that year."

questions.question: The disciple who was known to the high priest went with Jesus into the high priest's courtyard. Who was standing outside at the door?
options: Peter
Thomas
James
Andrew
questions.explanation: John 18:16 (ESV): "but Peter stood outside at the door. So the other disciple, who was known to the high priest, went out and spoke to the servant girl who kept watch at the door, and brought Peter in."

key_verse_text: Then Pilate said to him, "So you are a king?" Jesus answered, "You say that I am a king. For this purpose I was born and for this purpose I have come into the world—to bear witness to the truth."
